title: Polypiler spec family 'targets'
description: The body under 'spec' of spec/targets/<language identifier>/<profile>/target.yaml (PRD §4.1, §4.7): the physical types, ABI, alignment, pointer and union model, SIMD features, limits, runtime dependencies and packaging of one target profile. The document states facts about the target, never decisions; choosing native or helper for a program stays with the legalizer. Rules the schema cannot state (PLY0046): layout, pointer-consistency, limit-order, toolchain-known, type-fits-target, unique-type, unique-target; 'language' and every physical 'type' name an existing document (PLY0043).

language.description: The language document; its identifier is the first folder.

profile.description: The --target-profile value; equals the second folder. A dot is allowed because the C# profiles are target framework monikers (net10.0).

pointerBits.description: 0 exactly when pointers is none or fat (pointer-consistency).

physicalTypes.description: How each IR type is represented; each type once (unique-type).

native.description: The target's spelling of the type.

helper.description: Whether generated code needs a runtime helper for the type.

maxIntegerBits.description: The widest fixed-width integer the target computes with natively.

exactIntegerBits.description: The widest integer the target's default number type holds exactly; not above maxIntegerBits (limit-order).
